description:
Checks whether a signed document, an agreement, a receipt or a Share proof is genuine, and what it says.
It runs the same public check anyone can run at attest.datahubz.com/verify, with no account.
It takes one of: an agreement ID (agr_...), the verification code printed on the signed copy, at the foot of every page and on its signature stamps (ATT-XXXX-XXXX), a receipt ID (rcpt_...), a Share proof ID (azk_...), or a SHA-256 fingerprint (64 hex characters) of a file.
For a signed agreement it returns its status, each signer's name and signing time, whether every passkey signature checks out, and its blockchain anchor on Horizen. A private agreement is reported as private: its parties verify it through zero-knowledge proofs instead.
It takes a file's fingerprint, never the file itself: the SHA-256 can be computed on the person's device (for example shasum -a 256 file.pdf), or the file dropped on attest.datahubz.com/verify, where it is fingerprinted in the browser and never uploaded.
Text people typed (titles, notes, names, claims) comes only in untrustedText fields, apart from Attest's own wording. Email addresses, wherever they appear, were typed by people too (a sender chooses the signers' addresses) and are unverified input.

query.description: An agreement ID, an ATT-XXXX-XXXX verification code, a receipt ID, a proof ID, or a SHA-256 fingerprint.

name: verify_record

signers.description: In signing order; their names are in untrustedText.signerNames, in the same order.

link.description: The page on attest.datahubz.com where anyone can see this check run again.

coSigner.description: The co-signer's email address. An email address typed by a person (a sender chooses the signers' addresses): unverified input.

party.description: The prover's email address. An email address typed by a person (a sender chooses the signers' addresses): unverified input.

summary.description: The result in one or two plain sentences, in Attest's words (no typed text), safe to repeat to the person.

untrustedText.description: Unverified text people typed into Attest (titles, notes, names, file names, claims, reasons), some of it by other parties; Attest didn't write it and doesn't check it.

matches.description: The matching agreements' and certificates' titles (and a certificate's subject and issuer), by ID.

signerNames.description: The agreement's signers' names, in the order of agreement.signers.

verified.description: True only when every check passed; summary says what that means for this record.

title: Verify an Attest record
